nodes.data: We're now feeling confident enough in the stability and feature-completeness of 1.14 - The Village & Pillage Update - that we've decided to enter the pre-release phase. Whilst we know that there are still bugs to be solved and polish to be added, we feel that this version is now good enough that we can ask you all to please help us test and find any issues for a smooth release in a few weeks. Remember to report anything you find to our
, or give feedback on new features over to our
We're now on pre-release 5 and we expect this to be the last pre-release before the full release. We aim to release Village & Pillage for Minecraft: Java Edition on Tuesday, April 23rd.
Inside optimize world screen there's now an option to remove cached world data (e.g. height maps and light), so that it's recomputed on the next load

bugList.title: All short mobs drown just below the surface of water
Mobs heads rotate super quickly when looking around
Scaffolding switches quickly between entity and block when placed on some non-solid blocks
Cave ambient sounds are not playing
The tall grass in the plains village structures doesn't take the block it spawns on into consideration
Light sources spontaneously not working in some chunks
Skylight shines through blocks
Puffed puffer fishes with "NoAI" tag can shrink down
Mobs can suffocate below blocks, if the eye height isn't inside the collision box
Duplicated files in village structure
Spiders and cave spiders fly-climb
Trader llamas won't despawn
Barrels always try to set their "open" state to false
Crash while ticking barrel
Iron golems spawning at an alarming rate
Loom top texture is backwards
Eye position for riptiding player is incorrect
Villager can make the discount number of unstackable item more than 1
Trading sometimes takes the full price instead of the discounted price when player has the Hero of the Village effect
Drowned, fish and guardians are not spawning
When a zombie wakes up a villager, the bed tag is still on occupied (occupied: true)
Zombie villagers spawned with a zombie village move very fast
hs_pid_error appears for no reason in snapshots.
Shift-clicking an item out of the trading inventory instantly locks the trade
Villagers can trade Arrows of Luck
Villagers don't run away from ravagers, pillagers, vindicators, evokers, zombies or husks
Player can still move at normal speed and sprint while sneaking in a 1.5 blocks tall space
Villager 'Happy' and 'Angry' particles not showing, even when particles are on 'All'
Arrow facing down with 0 degrees on both x z (basically straight down) cannot be picked up and play a sound on loop
Player crouches with a delay
"Villager disagrees" sound is played twice when right clicking a villager without trades
Unable to focus anvil textfield by clicking
Background is not dimmed for book or lectern
Chunks stop loading after change view distance
Cannot drag any slider in "Video Settings" options
Mobs stop spawning over time if the render distance is less than 11
Command block text field isn't focused when opening the GUI anymore
Narrator is toggled when typing in text fields
X-ray with door and slab
